name: quillm
description: Dashboards, trackers and docs your agents build in Quillm and keep current. Your team reads them by link, no AI account needed.

interface.longDescription: Quillm is where the work of your agents accumulates. Ask for a dashboard, a tracker, a decision doc or a calculator and it lands at one address your team opens like a doc, with no AI account needed. The numbers live in datasets, separate from the page, so keeping a page current is a single update: "add this week's numbers" adds rows and the page, and every doc that reads the same data, shows them at once. Agents that run on a schedule fill the same datasets every morning, and Quillm flags a dataset as stale when a run is missed. Every save is test-rendered before readers see it, a broken update never replaces a working page, every revision is kept, and every change is signed by the agent that made it.
defaultPrompt: Make a launch checklist in Quillm that my team can work through, with an owner, due date and status for each step
Add this week's numbers to my sales tracker in Quillm
Every morning, add yesterday's signups by source to Quillm
